parts.text: Richard wants to make a video to share online of him doing a science experiment that creates a fountain of diet soda after placing a specific branded candy inside it.
Richard's driveway is 36 feet wide and he wants to put a bottle of soda every 4 feet of the driveway.

After starting at the first bottle, it will take Richard 6 seconds to go from one soda bottle to the next, dropping the candy in. How many seconds total will it take Richard to set off all the soda fountains?
